snippet.title: Chameleon - DYH: Season Finale Announcement (Jan 2026)
snippet.description:
Hello everyone.
Formerly called omegultragigaagoku here.
We wish to share with you our latest project.
Much of love and hard work brought our game to where it will be by the Season’s Finale’s release.
It reflects life lessons and stories since the last time we met.

Losing the videos and stopping the YouTube channel at the time was not by choice.
But it is by choice to start a new page.
To create and to share new things that will hopefully inspire.
Wishing you all only the best.
DYH

Song used:
Strom Theme (made by DYH)
#steam #anime #music #pcgaming #linuxgaming
